about.text: Sweet non-fermented cheese obtained from cow's or sheep's milk. Drained in cheesecloth could be eaten fresh, smoked, or further prepared into brânză de burduf.

facts.v: Kept in brine for 2–3 weeks, caș becomes telemea; it is also the raw material for brânză de burduf and cașcaval
In Negrilești, Vrancea, fresh caș is shaped into figures (păpuși) in moulds of sycamore wood
